text: Thanks for flagging this — I know it's frustrating, especially when the previous arrangement was different. The platform's policy has changed since we last spoke: stripping bed linen can no longer be required of guests, and I'm not permitted to charge Tomas for skipping it. That means no charge should go through for this stay. I'll need to update the house rules to remove that task, and I'm sorry for the confusion it caused you on this turnover.
